## STATUS CORRECTION — the implementation IS merged; earlier 'not pushed' notes are STALE

Earlier comments on this ticket state the fix was 'Not pushed to Gerrit and not submitted.' That
was accurate WHEN WRITTEN and is now out of date. It has since landed. Recording this explicitly
because those stale lines are the most recent claim in the ticket record about where the code
lives, and they misrepresent the current state.

**Merged as Gerrit change 2272, commit `f1dd41a8f099` ('Diagnose MCP client PAT wiring in
doctor'), LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1.**

Verified present on BOTH remotes at `be6263b9ae0b`:

    gerrit/main   src/rebar/_commands/doctor_mcp_client.py    PRESENT
    origin/main   src/rebar/_commands/doctor_mcp_client.py    PRESENT
    gerrit/main   tests/unit/test_doctor_mcp_client.py        PRESENT
    origin/main   tests/unit/test_doctor_mcp_client.py        PRESENT

`git show --stat f1dd41a8f099` confirms what it added: `doctor_mcp_client.py` (353 lines),
`test_doctor_mcp_client.py` (309 lines), the `doctor.py` wiring (20 lines), the durable
credential-delivery guidance in `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` (41 lines), and the three
`examples/mcp-clients/*` configs — 7 files, +732.

A follow-up (`--strict-mcp-clients`, the opt-in non-zero exit) landed in the same change after
review.

**One correction to my own reasoning while establishing this.** I first ran
`git cat-file -e <ref>:<path>` and got ABSENT for both files on both refs, and concluded the
verifier was right and I had been about to dispute it wrongly. That check was itself wrong — it
ran against stale refs before the fetch had taken effect. `git ls-tree -r gerrit/main` listed the
file, which is what exposed the contradiction. Re-run cleanly after fetching, both files are
present. Recording the false negative so the contradiction in this ticket's history is explained
rather than left hanging.
